title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
abstract: arXiv:2611.34402v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. translated_title: Any-Rate：基于编码位平面的半比特多精度大语言模型量化
translated_abstract: 嵌套多精度量化通过仅读取每个权重的最高有效位，从单一检查点派生出多种精度，这使其在各种内存和能耗预算下的端侧部署中极具吸引力。然而，现有方法仅支持整数比特，导致相邻精度之间存在较大的准确率差距，并且在2比特时出现严重的性能退化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Any-Rate，它能够从单一检查点提供2至8比特的精度服务，并在2至4比特范围内以半比特为步长进行调节。Any-Rate将部分位平面限制为8权重块中的扩展汉明码字（每权重0.5比特），在各精度之间共享每行一个查找表（LUT），并对所有精度进行联合编码，同时为每个精度设置独立的优化目标，从而降低了共享位平面带来的损失。在四个大语言模型上，Any-Rate在2比特和3比特下实现了多精度方法中最先进的准确率，在2比特下保持了FP16准确率的69%，在4比特下与最佳方法相差不到一个百分点。它解码……
tldr: Any-Rate通过将位平面约束为8权重块的扩展汉明码字并结合逐精度联合编码，实现了从单一检查点以半比特为步长提供2–8比特的多精度LLM量化，在2比特和3比特下达到最先进的准确率。
en_tdlr: Any-Rate achieves half-bit-granularity multi-precision LLM quantization (2–8 bits from a single checkpoint) by restricting bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks with joint per-precision encoding, delivering state-of-the-art accuracy at 2 and 3 bits.
